summary: Observed with the pinned Quint 0.32.0 binary: `quint test --main WorkspaceLifecycleTests` exited zero while discovering zero runs. An explicit seven-name `--match` selector, positive `7 passing` count, per-name assertions, and a never-match negative control close this false-green path in the installed acceptance script. Scope is this Quint CLI/version and selected model; it does not imply all test selectors behave identically.
title: Quint test exit does not prove discovery
